UN Human Rights Office accused of double standards on protests

The UN Human Rights Office has been accused of double standards regarding its response to protests and unrest. Coverage highlights that the UN expressed "concerns" over protests in India, specifically mentioning the CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace), while calling for "dialogue" in response to "violence, looting and arson" in Europe. This statement from the UN official came after weeks of footage showing chaotic scenes, police clashes, and arson across Europe.
